title: The keyboard
summary: Find white and black keys, and hear tones and semitones.

provenance.notes: Items drawn from the seeded generators with a teaching-point filter, then fixed. Music and answers come from the rule engine; prompts and feedback are original.

items.prompt: Find C on the keyboard. Any C is correct.
hints: Use the group of two black keys to find C, D and E.
Look for the groups of two and three black keys. C is just to the left of a group of two black keys.

feedback.correct: Spot on. The black-key groups are your map.

mistakes.white-key-off-by-one: Close — you're one white key away. Use the groups of two and three black keys to find your place.
mistakes.black-key-neighbour: Sharps are just to the right; flats are just to the left.
mistakes.enharmonic-spelling: That key is right, but here the note needs a different name. Think about which letter the question asks for.

feedback.fallback: Not quite. Find the nearest group of black keys and count from there.

items.prompt: Find B♭ on the keyboard. Any octave is correct.
hints: Use the group of two black keys to find C, D and E.
A flat is the key just to the left of (below) B.

feedback.correct: Yes. A black key has two names; both are the same key here.

mistakes.white-key-off-by-one: Close — you're one white key away. Use the groups of two and three black keys to find your place.
mistakes.black-key-neighbour: Sharps are just to the right; flats are just to the left.
mistakes.enharmonic-spelling: That key is right, but here the note needs a different name. Think about which letter the question asks for.

feedback.fallback: Not quite. Find the nearest group of black keys and count from there.

items.prompt: Is the distance between these two keys a tone or a semitone?

music.textAlternative: Two highlighted piano keys: C and the next-but-one key above it, D.

hints: Count the keys between them, black and white.
A semitone is from one key to the very next key, black or white. A tone is two semitones.

feedback.correct: Right. Count the keys in between, black and white.
